sentences: An operating system (OS) is a kind of computer program that helps a computer to interact with other machines or with people.
An OS is not actually one single program but a group of small programs, like file managers, device drivers, and kernels.
An OS can be small (like Damn Small Linux), or large (like Microsoft Windows).
Some are meant for general use, like in a personal computer or a smartphone.
Others are used for specific purposes.
For example, an ATM would use a specialized kind of operating system.
An operating system has many jobs.
It ensures that all the programs share access to the computer's processor, memory, screen, input devices, and other hardware.
Today, most operating systems also include a visible interface so the user can easily interact with it.
An operating system is also responsible for sending data to other computers or devices on a network.
Some examples of commonly used operating systems are: Android; macOS; Linux; Microsoft Windows.
The clock rate is the frequency at which a CPU is running.
It is the rate in cycles per second (measured in hertz) or the frequency of the clock in any synchronous circuit.
In general, many people think a higher clock speed means a faster processor, but other factors are also come into to picture.
You can not compare its performance based on only clock speed.
Depend upon the architecture design of the Processor, In some CPUs, a single instruction may be performed in a single clock cycle.
For Example, An Intel Core i5 1st generation has a clock speed of 3.2 GHz and the latest Intel Core i5 10th generation has a clock speed of 1.6 GHz.
Note: it is important to compare processors from the same brand and generation.
An online streamer or live streamer is a type of social media influencer who broadcasts themselves online through a live stream to an audience.
There are different formats: People show how they play video games.
People show themselves using a webcam, this is often done in the context of producing pornography; such people are known as webcam models.
People show their daily lives, walking around using a webcam.
Very often, people use advertising, or product placement to generate some earnings.
Sometimes, people also have a pay per view model.
This is often the case for streaming in the context of producing pornography.
Kinopoisk (Russian: Кинопоиск, a portmanteau of "cinema" and "search") is a Russian online database.
It started in 2003.
It has information about movies and TV shows including cast, production team, biographies, plot summaries, ratings, and reviews.
It also has stills, trailers, posters, and wallpapers.
Users can edit the information and post reviews.
From April 2018, Kinopoisk has an application for Samsung TVs with Smart TV function, which allows people to watch films for rent or purchase.
